import re

def redact_secrets(text):
    # sk- followed by at least 10 word chars or hyphens
    text = re.sub(r'sk-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}', '[REDACTED]', text)
    # Bearer <token>
    text = re.sub(r'Bearer\s+\S+', 'Bearer [REDACTED]', text)
    # password=<non-space>
    text = re.sub(r'(?i)password=\S+', 'password=[REDACTED]', text)
    return text

import re

def redact_secrets(text):
    # sk- followed by at least 10 alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen chars
    text = re.sub(r'sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}', '[REDACTED]', text)
    # Bearer followed by a non-space token
    text = re.sub(r'Bearer \S+', 'Bearer [REDACTED]', text)
    # password=<non-space> case-insensitive
    text = re.sub(r'(?i)password=\S+', 'password=[REDACTED]', text)
    return text

import re

def redact_secrets(text):
    text = re.sub(r'sk-[\w\-]{10,}', '[REDACTED]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'Bearer \S+', 'Bearer [REDACTED]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(?i)password=\S+', 'password=[REDACTED]', text)
    return text
